heading.purpose: H3 and row titles in ruled lists.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and small arrow-nudge transitions on hover. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action, one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 20px; background:#171717; color:#fff; border:1px solid #171717; border-radius:4px; font:500 15px/1.25 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#404040; border-color:#404040; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #171717; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 20px; background:#fff; color:#171717; border:1px solid #c4c4c4; border-radius:4px; font:500 15px/1.25 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#171717; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #171717; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with label above and error below.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font:500 14px/1.4 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color:#171717; } .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; margin-top:6px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #c4c4c4; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; color:#171717; font:400 16px/1.5 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#171717; outline:2px solid #171717; outline-offset:0; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:#b42318; }

components.name: Ruled Service Row
components.description: Signature list pattern: hairline-ruled rows with title, arrow and one-line summary.
components.html: Cloud & Data Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, DevOps, data engineering, analytics and modernisation.
components.css: .ds-row { display:block; padding:24px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5; color:#171717; text-decoration:none; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-title { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-row-title svg { transition:transform .15s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-title svg { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-row-text { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:#5c5c5c; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Placeholder Note
components.html: Placeholder: verified outcome to be supplied by the delivery team.
components.css: .ds-placeholder { padding:12px 16px; border:1px dashed #c4c4c4; border-radius:4px; background:#fff; color:#5c5c5c; font:400 14px/1.6 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-placeholder strong { color:#171717; font-weight:600; }

narrative.northStar: Ink on paper: a capability statement, not a startup landing page
narrative.overview: Text-first, black-and-white corporate site for an established AI and software engineering partner. Structure comes from hairline rules, definition lists and the Paper/Mist alternation; the purple logo is the only colour.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled lists instead of card grids

rules.name: One colour rule
rules.body: The logo is the only chromatic element.

rules.name: Mist contrast rule
rules.body: Body copy on Mist uses Muted Strong (#5C5C5C).

rules.name: No kickers
rules.body: Headings stand alone, with no eyebrow labels.

dos: Use ruled rows and definition lists for structured content
Keep interactions legible with motion disabled
donts: Don't add icon tiles, stock imagery, gradients or glass
Don't publish unapproved figures, names or outcomes
